title: Move CLAUDE.md incident history out of the always-read file
problem: CLAUDE.md is 1,662 lines, about 1,000 of them dated incident narratives. Every run reads it, it is the most-reported friction file, and the narratives bury the commands. A long rulebook also crowds out judgment (prompts/steering.md).
evidence: CLAUDE.md: 12 doc-friction reports, the most of any file: python3 prompts/promptctl.py measure (doc friction), 2026-10-15
Recommended by both studies (prompts/process/reports/2026-10-15-addendum.md, rec 3) and by review R1 (prompts/experiments.md)
change: Keep each section's rule, command and one line of why in CLAUDE.md, and move the narratives verbatim to docs/history/claude-md.md so nothing is lost.
metric: CLAUDE.md lines (measure, 'Instruction lines'); CLAUDE.md friction reports per run
